crossRefs.note: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed…
He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and…
After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

people.name: Assos
people.line: A seaport in Mysia, visited by Paul.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.
translations.bsb: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed to Assos, where we were to take Paul aboard. He had arranged this because he was going there on foot.
translations.kjv: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
translations.asv: But we going before to the ship set sail for Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, intending himself to go by land.
